correctness.rationale: For all tau>1, omega>0, xi>0 the direct Jacobian calculation yields trace -(A+B xi) and determinant (tau-1)xi. Its discriminant factors with the two exact positive roots xi_- and xi_+. The derivative of the smaller decay root changes sign only at the upper critical speed, and within the focus interval the rate is increasing. The fast-limit value and exact gain follow algebraically. Nonzero coupling makes both boundary double eigenvalues defective. At a focus, angular velocity is bounded from zero locally while radius decreases, yielding infinitely many damped y=y_* crossings. SymPy symbolic calculation, one exact Jordan matrix, and 180 independent rational cases were checked; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The fixed-ratio speed sweep isolates a genuinely interpretable epidemiological control variable while leaving endemic burden unchanged. The unique finite speed strictly outperforms arbitrarily fast adjustment by a parameter-explicit factor up to two, and the exact node-to-focus-to-node interval maps transiently recurrent infection-level crossings. This is a sharp structural response-time phase diagram for the initiating model, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a known equilibrium restatement.
